thread:
tom_ae: Kicking off Helix migration POC. They're running an on-product assistant and want to swap CompetitorX for Redwood with minimal changes. Key asks: API surface parity, prompt/response equivalence, short pricing parity for their flat monthly plan, and security questionnaire answers by Thu. Who owns what? cc @sasha_presales @mike_se

sasha_presales: I can lead the POC and own the runbook. Propose 10 core prompts + 10 edge-case prompts from Helix. We should offer a tiny compatibility adapter they can drop in. Also propose pass/fail criteria: >=90% acceptance on eval set, no regression on safety checks, p95 latency within 2x baseline.

mike_se: Adapter notes: CompetitorX uses header `X-COMP-KEY` and endpoint `/v1/stream`; returns SSE-style `data: {...}`. Redwood supports chunked JSON streaming. Simple proxy will translate headers and stream frames. Quick shim (example):
```bash
# POST /compat -> Redwood /v1/generate
curl -X POST https://canary.redwood/compat \
  -H 'X-COMP-KEY: $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","prompt":"${PROMPT}"}'
```
I'll spin up a demo repo and stage deploy.

vivian_security: Helix's legal asks: SOC2 report, option for customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and data flow diagram. Quick answers: SOC2 available; CMK only for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem); hosted supports envelope encryption but not customer-controlled KMS. VPC peering supported in Private. Mark CMK-on-hosted as a blocker unless they accept Private. I'll draft the questionnaire responses into the shared drive.

nora_pricing: If they currently pay flat monthly we need their 90-day call volume + avg tokens per call. We can propose a blended POC rate to mirror their spend (30-90 day term) to remove friction. Share volumes and I'll run a parity estimate.

sam_csm: I'll set up the eval harness. Need the 20 prompts and any safety sample text. Will run nightly diffs and report script showing token deltas and example divergences. Also will include regression alerting if hallucination rate changes.

deploy-bot: deploy: compat-shim-demo -> staging-3 succeeded - https://staging.canary.redwood/compat :white_check_mark:

tom_ae: Great. Action items: 1) Sasha send invite to Helix for kickoff (tomorrow 11am PST), 2) Helix to share prompts + volumes, 3) Vivian to upload security Q answers, 4) Mike deploy shim demo, 5) Nora to prepare blended POC pricing. We'll escalate CMK-hosted ask if Helix insists.

sasha_presales: Invite sent to infra@helixdata.com and legal@helixdata.com. Meeting tomorrow 11am PST. Mike/Nora/Vivian/Sam please join.

mike_se: I'll post the shim repo link and a short diff report after first-run.

Tom_ae: Thanks everyone, I'll update the customer after the meeting.
